city.intro: Our old town sits on a small peninsula and is a UNESCO World Heritage Site — cobbled lanes, wooden houses and churches hundreds of years old. All around are sandy beaches, trips along the coast, and everything you need to know for a relaxed stay.

beaches.heading: Beaches
beaches.intro: The sea is practically around the corner. Pick one to suit your mood.

trips.heading: Trips
trips.intro: When you want to venture further, there are plenty of spots nearby for a day trip.
